# GM Studio

GM Studio is a browser workspace for inspecting and editing a small set of OpenMC-style geometry starters.

- Main application: https://gm.keff.uk/
- Model and import limits: https://gm.keff.uk/docs/
- Benchmark references: https://gm.keff.uk/docs/benchmarks/
- Agent guide: https://gm.keff.uk/docs/agents/
- Catalog JSON: https://gm.keff.uk/api/models.json
- OpenAPI: https://gm.keff.uk/openapi.json
- MCP endpoint: https://gm.keff.uk/api/mcp
- MCP server card: https://gm.keff.uk/.well-known/mcp.json

This preview uses a Canvas sketch. It does not contain the planned C++/WebAssembly geometry kernel, a GPU CSG renderer, a BEAVRS model, or an OpenMC runtime. Benchmark cards are source references only. Generic reactor layouts are schematic.

Model edits and browser autosaves stay on the device. Files supplied to the agent endpoint are processed for that request and are not stored by this app.
